interpretation_limits: CS kept and removed quantities came from CS full-wallet NAV and risk sizing; their summed cash contributions are attribution, not separately tradable equal-capital strategies.
AGREEMENT quantities incorporate a different realized NAV path and different covariance-based sizing. Removing CS contributions is not a causal return counterfactual.

The saved NO_REALLOCATION diagnostic has independent wallet NAV, differs from literal CS-quantity subtraction, and can raise estimated risk when hedges are removed. It remains a diagnostic and cannot rescue failed primary gates.
Known historical development years and conditional daily quantity proxy only; no execution, capacity, liquidation or pristine holdout qualification.

method.excluded: No new account replay, target generation, RNG, fitting, parameter search, shortened calendar, winner selection, protected 2026 data, external downloads or publication
method.expense_partitions: Opening/increasing units use current holding side and gate; closing/decreasing units use previous holding side and previous ownership-date gate; reversals split close/open. Terminal cost uses final holding. This explicit convention is additive, not a causal cost allocation.
method.gate: Saved agreement_mask and target proof at ownership date; raw_CS defines original long/short leg intent
method.rebalance: -abs(current saved quantity - previous saved quantity) * original p0 * .00135; prior initial inventory is zero
method.source_identity: Published RESULTS and quantity hashes, original input and saved target/proof hashes verified before arithmetic
method.terminal: -abs(last saved quantity) * last original p1 * .00135; separated from final saved row trading_cost_proxy

next_research_direction.falsifiable_design: On admitted seen-development calendars only, retain CS rank rules, original signed funding and execution costs; freeze one causal inventory/risk adjustment recipe and full-calendar economic gates before replay. Preserve market-neutral hedge structure, account for covariance/cap constraints, and report turnover plus net and drawdown. No search or holdout access is authorized by this attribution.
next_research_direction.no_free_savings: Same-sign and non-rank-date expenses are research targets, not avoidable-cost estimates. 2023 needs over 89.72 USDT improvement; even deleting all 81.63 non-rank-date fees arithmetically would still leave CS negative before inventory changes.
preserved_failures: CSMOM_ABSOLUTE_SHORT_20261008 own-21-day-return short gate: targeted DEDUP_REVIEW records worse net and drawdown in three windows despite removing historical XRP liquidation.
Prior failed SMA hard gate and additive SMA/CS mix remain failed evidence; no reset, rescue by diagnostic, or untested rebranding of a sign gate.
This frozen symmetric daily SMA200 AGREEMENT fails the published primary qualification in both full years.
next_research_direction.rationale: 2025 lost price PnL overwhelms saved fees; profitable rejected shorts show absolute downtrend is not necessary for cross-sectional shorts. In 2023 ungated CS has positive price PnL but is made net-negative by turnover costs and funding.
next_research_direction.recommendation: Preserve CS relative ranking and long/short hedge structure; prioritize a single predeclared transaction-cost-aware inventory/risk-rebalancing experiment rather than another absolute-sign hard gate.

scope: 2023 and 2025; all 365 dates each; original saved CS, AGREEMENT and predeclared AGREEMENT_NO_REALLOCATION holdings only
units: USDT contributions; funding cash positive means receipt; expense contributions negative. Percentage points are USDT/10000*100, not independent strategy returns.
